risks.title: Cyber threats and data protection
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K with quarterly briefings to the Audit Committee and direct CSO involvement. Strong language on growing ransomware threats. Highly critical category for a data security software vendor.

risks.title: Dependence on a key distributor
risks.score_rationale: Arrow represents 35-37% of revenues. Explicit mention of material impact if agreement is terminated. Recurring risk and specifically quantified in the 10-K.

risks.title: Headquarters sale and restructuring
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 2: headquarters sale in 2026 with transition to lease. Major operational change but planned and controlled. Neutral language, no risk alerts.

risks.title: Foreign currency fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: 46-48% of revenues from international operations. Foreign exchange losses of 1.5M$ in 2025. Moderate but recurring and measured impact.

risks.title: Ongoing legal risk
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 3: no material litigation in progress. Reassuring language (not reasonably expected to have negative effect). Category weighted as minor.

risks.title: Indirect revenue concentration
risks.score_rationale: 90% of subscription revenues flow through indirect channels. Risk stated clearly: any partner failure would have a material effect.

ai_positioning.summary: CVLT does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The provided data focuses primarily on financial information, operations, and the company's cyber resilience, with references to automation and validation in recovery solutions, but without explicit AI positioning.
